# WO-191: Cover the human-readable checklist show output
Status: delivered; owner review requested
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Nora Bennett (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Hannah Cole
Source: CX test-gap scan by Ravi Menon; no matching existing test suite or issue found

## Goal
Protect the visible human-readable `freemyid checklist show ID` output, including optional sections and literal user-provided checklist text.

## Acceptance criteria
- Add `tests/codex/test_cx_cli_checklist_text.py`.
- Use synthetic `Checklist` data and stub `_checklist_context` plus `checklist_state.ticks`; do not open a real store or load the public checklist file.
- Assert that a sample's title, status, why, cost, time, website, numbered steps in order, undo guidance, checked date, and completion command appear in the text output.
- Cover `need_on_hand` and `status_note` when present, and verify their sections are absent when values are empty/None.
- Include bracketed sample text (for example `[read the notice]`) and confirm it appears literally in the output, without Rich interpreting it as markup.
- Keep this test-only; run the focused pytest and Ruff commands below and record exact results in the worktree `VENDOR_STATUS.md`.
- If a failure reveals a real product defect, do not edit `src/`; report the evidence and use a strict xfail only for the specific affected assertion.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `tests/codex/test_cx_cli_checklist_text.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No edits to `src/`, existing tests, `docs/CLI.md`, models, checklist data, JSON contract, profile isolation, store/consent logic, configuration, CI, or dependencies. Do not use real checklist, registry, store, network, or personal data.

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_cli_checklist_text.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_cli_checklist_text.py`

## Check-in plan
